g.text: A semester-two workshop and materials study of mechanical precision, proportion and manual
The project began as a hands-on study of traditional bolt-action rifle
proportions and their precise mechanical character.
Traditional single-barrel and bolt-action forms informed the relationship
between stock, barrel and mechanical detailing.
A mild-steel rod formed the barrel and was sleeved precisely into a stock
carved from one piece of teak. Alignment had to remain consistent across the
The spokeshave proved more effective than a planer on the stock’s curved
surfaces, offering finer control over continuous ergonomic transitions.
The finished life-scale model resolves barrel, stock and mechanical detail into
one study of structural proportion and hand-shaped form.
